candidates.source_name: NBS – Publikácie (master publications hub / rozcestník)
candidates.why_relevant: Single authoritative index of every NBS narrative publication series (annual report, financial stability report, analytical comments, quick comments, macroprudential commentary, data insights, blogs, Biatec archive, discontinued series). Best snowball root for the whole non-statistical layer of NBS output on payments and cash.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the index page to enumerate series URLs; then per-series listing crawl for new items (monthly cadence).
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of publications hub after sk-language search
queries_used: NBS správa o finančnej stabilite hotovosť v obehu platby

candidates.source_name: NBS – Výročná správa (Annual Report)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual narrative report contains dedicated chapters on issuance of banknotes and coins (emisia bankoviek a mincí), cash circulation (hotovostný peňažný obeh), and payment systems (platobný styk / SIPS, TARGET) — with commentary and charts not present in raw statistics tables.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download (SK + EN); extract cash-circulation and payment-systems chapters; historical archive back to 1990s available under /_img/documents/_publikacie/vyrocnasprava/.
queries_used: NBS výročná správa emisia bankoviek a mincí hotovostné peňažné obeh

candidates.source_name: NBS – Správa o finančnej stabilite (Financial Stability Report)
candidates.why_relevant: Semi-annual flagship narrative report on the Slovak financial sector; interprets banking-sector, retail-payment and household-behaviour trends, and carries analytical boxes that frequently touch digitalisation of payments and cash demand.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Twice-yearly PDF/HTML capture; index the analytical boxes separately (they are where payment/cash themes appear).
queries_used: NBS správa o finančnej stabilite hotovosť obeh platby

candidates.source_name: NBS – Analytické komentáre (Analytical Comments)
candidates.why_relevant: Short analyst-authored notes on topical issues; the natural home for one-off analyses of payment behaviour, card/contactless adoption, cash demand shocks and digital euro. Charts here are often not reproducible from the statistics portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly listing crawl with keyword filter (platb*, hotovos*, karta, bezkontaktn*, bankomat, POS).
queries_used: NBS analytický komentár platobné karty bezkontaktné platby nbs.sk

candidates.source_name: NBS – Rýchle komentáre (Quick Comments)
candidates.why_relevant: Rapid-reaction notes published alongside data releases; useful for catching NBS's own interpretation/revision narrative within days of a statistical publication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl / RSS if available; keyword filter.
queries_used: nbs.sk publikacie rychle komentare

candidates.source_name: NBS – Čo hovoria dáta (What the Data Say)
candidates.why_relevant: Explicitly data-storytelling series: takes NBS/ECB micro and macro datasets and turns them into charted narratives. High likelihood of card/cash/payment-behaviour visualisations that do not exist elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl; capture embedded charts and underlying data links.
queries_used: nbs.sk "čo hovoria dáta" platby hotovosť blog

candidates.source_name: NBS – Blogy NBS (NBS Blog)
candidates.why_relevant: Least-formal narrative channel; carries staff pieces on cash usage and payment digitalisation (e.g. 'Hotovosť neumiera'). Often the earliest public airing of an internal analysis.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl with keyword filter; treat as commentary, not data of record.
queries_used: nbs.sk "čo hovoria dáta" platby hotovosť blog

candidates.source_name: NBS – Aktuality / press releases
candidates.why_relevant: Primary press-release stream. Historically the channel for payment-market interventions and interpretation: contactless limit raise from EUR 20 to EUR 50 (agreed with the Slovak Banking Association), instant-payments rollout, access of non-bank PSPs to SIPS/TARGET-SK, digital euro communication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly listing crawl or RSS; keyword filter on platb*, hotovos*, bankomat, karta, SIPS, TARGET, digitálne euro.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search snowball across multiple queries

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately published NBS payment-systems oversight report (an equivalent of an annual 'Správa o dohľade nad platobnými systémami') was found as its own publication series on nbs.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-system oversight is described as a standing NBS function on the /platby and /historia/target2-sk-a-sips pages, and oversight outcomes appear to be reported inside the Annual Report's payment-systems chapter rather than in a dedicated report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector should not wait for a dedicated oversight report; the oversight narrative must be extracted from the annual report and the payments section instead.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak equivalent of a dedicated annual 'cash report' / 'Správa o hotovostnom peňažnom obehu' as a standalone publication series was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-circulation narrative is distributed across annual-report chapters ('emisia bankoviek a mincí', 'hotovostný peňažný obeh'), blog posts such as 'Hotovosť neumiera', and the banknotes-and-coins section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-usage intelligence for SK must be assembled from several channels rather than a single serial document; increases collection cost and the risk of missing content.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovak did not surface any NBS narrative publication series specifically about ATM (bankomat) networks or POS terminal acceptance infrastructure.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS terms appear only incidentally in consumer-information pages and press releases; no analytical series dedicated to acceptance infrastructure was found at NBS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM/POS coverage in workstream A4 will likely have to come from the statistics portal (other cell), the Slovak Banking Association, or commercial acquirers rather than from NBS narrative output.

negative_findings.description: Individual item-level inventories for the analytical-comment, quick-comment, data-insight and blog series were not enumerated in this pass; only the series landing pages were established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Series URLs are confirmed from the publications hub, but the per-item payment/cash yield of each series is inferred rather than measured.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Priority scores for those series are provisional; a follow-up item-level crawl is needed before committing collection effort.

negative_findings.description: Several legacy www.nbs.sk and /_img/documents/ PDF paths appeared in search results but were not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Their liveness is unknown; they are recorded as candidates with reduced confidence, not as verified live URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should treat any 403/timeout on these as bot-defence or migration, not as dead, and should consult the Wayback Machine before dropping them.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS speeches, presentations and Governor/Board-member remarks were not systematically located as a distinct channel; these often disclose payment- and cash-policy direction before publications do.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search nbs.sk for 'prejavy', 'vystúpenia', 'prezentácie', 'guvernér' and add a speeches channel to this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed or newsletter endpoint was identified for aktuality or the publication series, so the proposed collection method relies on listing diff-crawls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe nbs.sk for /feed, /rss and any 'odber noviniek' subscription mechanism to enable event-driven collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The completeness of the EN mirror versus the SK tree is unmeasured; some payment/cash commentary is likely SK-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a paired SK/EN listing crawl and quantify the translation gap per series before deciding whether SK-language NLP is mandatory.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of the narrative layer (pre-2010 annual-report cash and payment chapters, full Biatec run 1993–2019) has been identified but not inventoried.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a one-off archival harvest of the legacy /_img/documents tree and the Biatec ročník index, cross-checked against the Wayback Machine.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS narrative frequently reflects ECB/Eurosystem work (e.g. the euro-area consumer payment-habits study referenced in NBS aktuality). The ECB-side originals sit outside this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Coordinate with the cell covering ECB/Eurosystem sources so SPACE-type euro-area payment-habits studies with Slovak country breakouts are not lost between cells.

brief: The NBS non-statistical layer is a single-publisher but multi-channel landscape, all reachable from one hub at nbs.sk/publikacie/: serial reports (výročná správa, správa o finančnej stabilite, supervision activity reports), a dense commentary tier (analytické komentáre, rýchle komentáre, makroprudenciálny komentár, čo hovoria dáta, blog), a methodological tier (odbor štatistiky metodika, metodické informácie a oznamy, supervisory metodické usmernenia), and a high-volume press stream (aktuality) that carries the operative payment-market interventions such as the contactless limit rise to EUR 50 and the October 2025 opening of SIPS/TARGET-SK to non-bank PSPs. Cash-usage narrative is not consolidated in any dedicated cash report — it is distributed across annual-report emission chapters, the bankovky a mince section, and staff blog pieces — and there is no NBS narrative series dedicated to ATM or POS acceptance infrastructure, which is the sharpest gap for this workstream. Two structural quirks matter for collection: a partial EN mirror at nbs.sk/en/publications/ that leaves some material SK-only, and a still-serving legacy tree (www.nbs.sk, /_img/documents/) that holds the pre-redesign historical PDFs and the discontinued Biatec journal. All listed URLs are candidate locations with stated confidence; none were verified for liveness in this pass.
